I'm sorry to hear your order arrived damaged! Here's what you should do:
Document the Damage Take clear photos of:
The damaged packaging itself
The entire product and close-ups of the affected areas
A common object next to the damage to show scale
The law tag showing the barcode (both front and back if available)
Note your unboxing date as well.
Contact Our Support Team I can connect you with our team right away to help process this. They'll need:
Your order details and email
Current shipping address
The photos and description of the damage
The team will review your documentation and guide you through the next steps. Processing time for replacement requests may take up to 7 business days, not including any production time needed.
Important timing note: If your damaged item is furniture, please reach out within 3 days of delivery to arrange a repair, replacement, or return. Returns due to verified manufacturing defects are eligible for a full refund or replacement under our warranty.
